import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_points = scanner.nextInt();
        int multiplier = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] k_list = new int[total_points];
        for (int x = 0; x < total_points; x++) {
            k_list[x] = (int)((long)multiplier * x % total_points);
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points - 1, MOD_CONST));
            return;
        } else if (multiplier == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points, MOD_CONST));
            return;
        }

        int[] visited = new int[total_points];
        int[] cycle_counts = new int[total_points + 1]; // size up to total_points
        long answer = 1;

        for (int start = 0; start < total_points; start++) {
            if (visited[start] != 0) continue;
            int length = 1;
            int current = start;
            visited[current] = 1;
            while (visited[k_list[current]] == 0) {
                current = k_list[current];
                visited[current] = 1;
                length++;
            }
            cycle_counts[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 2; size < total_points; size++) {
            if (cycle_counts[size] != 0) {
                long total_size = (long) size * cycle_counts[size] + 1;
                answer = (answer * powMod(total_size, cycle_counts[size], MOD_CONST)) % MOD_CONST;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base % mod;
        long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur) % mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
